notes.title: Version 1.2
notes.notes:
The following changes have been made:

Game System Changes


 Removed the item bag option, allowing players to carry up to 7 items from the start.


Game Balance Adjustments


 Adjusted the parameters of various cards to match the increased item slots.
 Slightly increased the recovery rate of the status effects "Blind" and "Dizziness" when moving to the next round.
 Limited the effect of the Ring of Growth to weapons and shields.


UI Improvements


 Added the ability to skip a card with a right-click during card selection.
 When selecting a weapon card while a weapon is equipped, players can now directly trade in and purchase the new weapon.
 Added the ability to open the item details screen using the mouse wheel.

notes.title: Version 1.1
notes.notes:
The following changes have been made:

New Game Mode Added


 Added a mode where damage during attacks is fixed.


Game Balance Adjustments


 Adjusted so that powerful cards are less likely to appear at the beginning of a round.
 Eased the unlocking conditions for game modes and stages.
 Adjusted the parameters of certain enemies.
 Adjusted the parameters of certain items.
 Adjusted the amount of HP recovered when skipping (changed from 10% of max HP to 15%).
 Enhanced the altar that increases max HP in exchange for equipment.
 Adjusted so that gold cards now appear in the Dragon’s Cave.
 Adjusted the damage calculation logic (reduced the randomness slightly).


UI Improvements


 Added damage range display to player status information.
 Added frames for weapons, shields, and items.


Others


 Added the probability of special attacks to card descriptions.
